ouroboros.contracts.v1.ByteInterval.json.description: ByteInterval is a half-open raw-byte interval [start_byte, end_byte).

endByte.description: end_byte is exclusive and must be >= start_byte.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ByteInterval.json.title: Byte Interval

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.description: Digest identifies immutable bytes using a named digest algorithm.

algorithm.description: algorithm identifies the canonical digest algorithm, for example sha256.

hex.description: hex is the lower-case encoded digest value.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.title: Digest

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.description: Identifier is an opaque, stable identifier within a declared namespace.

namespace.description: namespace prevents an identifier string from crossing a domain boundary.

value.description: value is opaque to consumers and must be non-empty after boundary validation.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.title: Identifier

ouroboros.contracts.v1.LineInterval.json.description: LineInterval is a half-open one-based line interval [start_line, end_line).

endLine.description: end_line is exclusive and must be >= start_line.

startLine.description: start_line is inclusive and one-based when non-zero.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.LineInterval.json.title: Line Interval

budgetsDigest.description: budgets_digest pins non-secret budget ceilings from ConfigSnapshot.

geminiSecretRef.description: gemini_secret_ref is a Keychain reference for the Gemini route.

githubEffectIdentityKind.description: github_effect_identity_kind is github_app, fine_grained_pat, or tbd.

githubIdentitySecretRef.description: github_identity_secret_ref is a Keychain or secret-store reference name.

implementerModelFamily.description: implementer_model_family is the live implement path family (for example openai).

modalAuthSecretRef.description: modal_auth_secret_ref is a Keychain or secret-store reference name.

modalTtlSeconds.description: modal_ttl_seconds is the hard Modal lifetime ceiling (default 1800).

openaiSecretRef.description: openai_secret_ref is a Keychain reference for the OpenAI route.

retentionDigest.description: retention_digest pins retention policy without secret plaintext.

reviewerModelFamily.description: reviewer_model_family is the fresh review family and must differ at runtime.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.TracerConfigSurfa.title: Tracer Config Surface

ouroboros.contracts.v1.TracerManifest.js.description:
TracerManifest pins the immutable identity of one Tracer 001 fixture run.
 Changing any element of the identity tuple creates a new run.

aclEpoch.description: acl_epoch pins the ACL epoch for authorized reads.

authorizedPrincipalId.description: authorized_principal_id is principal A with minimum required grants.

baseGitOid.description: base_git_oid is the exact repository base commit OID (40 or 64 hex).

configDigest.description: config_digest pins the resolved non-secret ConfigSnapshot.

configSurface.description: config_surface freezes non-secret dogfood slots (secrets stay out of git).

deniedPrincipalId.description: denied_principal_id is principal B (denied and post-revoke).

dynamicLeafMax.description: dynamic_leaf_max is the inclusive upper bound on dynamic-N (always 3).

dynamicLeafMin.description: dynamic_leaf_min is the inclusive lower bound on dynamic-N (always 1).

issueBundleDigest.description: issue_bundle_digest pins the issue-evidence bundle bytes.

manifestDigest.description: manifest_digest binds the canonical identity tuple of this manifest.

pinStatus.description: pin_status is unpinned until Sammy resolves the fixture pin checklist.

policyDigest.description: policy_digest pins the policy bounds applied to the run.

schemaVersion.description: schema_version is the frozen manifest schema identity (tracer-001/v1).

sfsSnapshotDigest.description: sfs_snapshot_digest pins the reconstructed SFS source snapshot bytes.

sourceRevisionDigest.description: source_revision_digest pins the immutable source revision metadata.

supportingAnchorDigest.description: supporting_anchor_digest pins the canonical anchor serialization.

supportingSpanBytes.description: supporting_span_bytes is the expected raw-byte interval of the supporting span.

supportingSpanDigest.description: supporting_span_digest pins the extracted span bytes without normalization.

supportingSpanLines.description: supporting_span_lines is the expected line interval of the supporting span.

supportingSpanPath.description: supporting_span_path is the repository-relative path of the one supporting span.

tenantId.description: tenant_id is an opaque test tenant identity.

tracerId.description: tracer_id is the fixed tracer identity.

variants.description: variants lists the five co-equal arms derived from this manifest.

workflowDigest.description: workflow_digest pins the expected WorkflowIR / plan shape digest.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.TracerManifest.js.title: Tracer Manifest

ouroboros.contracts.v1.TracerVariant.jso.description: TracerVariant is one derived arm of the pinned manifest (positive or negative).

expectedPublicReason.description:
expected_public_reason is the external non-disclosing reason when abstaining.
 Positive authorized path may leave this empty; negatives use not_found_or_denied
 externally while recording the internal SPAN_* code in reason_code.

reasonCode.description: reason_code is the stable internal Tracer 001 reason for this arm.

variantDigest.description: variant_digest binds the independent expected digests for this arm.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.TracerVariant.jso.title: Tracer Variant
